John W. Work, Jr.'s dates (1871–1925) are from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Wesley_Work_Jr.; CCEH's page gives only the year 1907. Frederick J. Work's dates (died 1942) are from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frederick_Jerome_Work (c. 1879 - 1942); CCEH's page gives only the year 1907. The page gives no year for the tune itself; it was in print by 1907, the year of the arrangement.
